title: Make Copilot in Teams meetings work: transcription and recording policies
problem: Users can't use Copilot in meetings, or Copilot disappears after the meeting.
steps: Transcription must be allowed (Teams meeting policy, -AllowTranscription) and a transcript started for Copilot to work after the meeting.
Organizers choose 'During and after the meeting', 'Only during the meeting' or 'Off' in meeting options.
Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Recording & transcription > Copilot: On, On with saved transcript required (default), On with transcript saved by default, or Off.
pitfalls: 'Only during the meeting' means no post-meeting recap — users think Copilot is broken.
The Copilot default comes from the organizer's meeting policy; transcription can be started by any participant whose own policy allows it.
Copilot isn't available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.
done_when: The meeting policy for pilot users allows transcription and has the Copilot setting you chose.
In a test meeting where a transcript was started, Copilot can still be used on that meeting after it ends.

sources.title: Manage Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events
MC1508234: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies (Message center mirror)

troubleshooting.symptom: The organiser does not see 'Record and transcribe' or 'Transcribe only' under Record and transcribe automatically
troubleshooting.cause: Since MC1508234 (Targeted Release from mid-November 2026, GA December 2026) Meeting options only show the automatic options the organiser's effective meeting policy allows; with transcription blocked only 'Record only' and 'Off' remain
troubleshooting.fix: Check the organiser's effective policy (direct, group or global) with `Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> | Select-Object AllowCloudRecording,AllowTranscription` and change `AllowTranscription` on the policy if transcripts should be possible.

troubleshooting.symptom: No automatic recording/transcription setting at all in Meeting options
troubleshooting.cause: Per MC1508234, when both recording and transcription are blocked by policy the automatic setting is not shown
troubleshooting.fix: Expected behaviour; allow at least one of `AllowCloudRecording` or `AllowTranscription` in the policy if needed.

troubleshooting.symptom: Meetings recorded with 'Record only' have no Copilot recap
troubleshooting.cause: 'Record only' starts recording without a transcript, and Copilot after the meeting needs a transcript
troubleshooting.fix: Use 'Record and transcribe' for meetings where Copilot after the meeting is wanted, or set the Copilot policy to require a saved transcript.

rollback: Set the meeting policy's Copilot value back to the previous setting with `Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -Copilot <previous value>` and confirm with `Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> | Select-Object Copilot,AllowTranscription`.
If transcription was enabled only for the pilot, remove the pilot users from the policy assignment so they fall back to the previous group or global policy.

history.note: Added troubleshooting for the policy-aligned automatic recording/transcription options and the new 'Record only' option (MC1508234), plus rollback.
